credit_line: Museum purchase: Letha Churchill Walker Memorial Art Fund, Spencer Museum of Art, The University of Kansas, 1977.0043
description: Blue and green mountains stretch across the composition. Beyond these are two additional mountains, one light pink and the other vibrant pink. The sky above the landscape is light purple.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
